# pods-control

macOS CLI for AirPods and Beats listening modes.

The binary is `pods-control`. `airpods-control` is the same binary and prints
nothing extra. The command was formerly `airpods-control`.

Install with `brew install raulgg/tap/pods-control` or
`brew install airpods-control`. Until the `pods-control` formula is published,
`brew install raulgg/tap/airpods-control` still installs the current formula.

This project is not CocoaPods and not Kubernetes. It runs on macOS only: not
iOS, Windows, Linux, or Android, and not through Control Center or
Accessibility.

Commands: `status`, `listening-mode` (`lm`), `conversation-awareness` (`ca`),
and `support-report`. `man pods-control` and `man airpods-control` show the
same page.
